name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: MuddyWater (G0069)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to MuddyWater (G0069; aliases: Earth Vetala, MERCURY, Static Kitten, Seedworm, TEMP.Zagros, Mango Sandstorm, TA). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data - MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
